Here is an overview of the Marriott Bonvoy credit cards available on Marriott.com:

---

### **Personal Credit Cards**

#### **1. Marriott Bonvoy Boundless® Credit Card from Chase**
- **Annual Fee:** $95
- **Welcome Offer:** Earn 100,000 Points after spending $3,000 on eligible purchases in the first 3 months, plus up to $100 in airline credits.
- **Earning Rates:**
  - Up to 17X total points per $1 spent at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels.
  - 3X points per $1 on the first $6,000 spent combined annually on gas stations, grocery stores, and dining.
  - 2X points per $1 on all other purchases.
- **Key Benefits:**
  - 1 Free Night Award every year after card account anniversary (redemption level up to 35,000 points).
  - Automatic Silver Elite Status.
  - Path to Gold Elite Status by spending $35,000 each calendar year.
  - 15 Elite Night Credits every calendar year, plus 1 Elite Night Credit for every $5,000 spent.

---

#### **2. Marriott Bonvoy Bold® Credit Card from Chase**
- **Annual Fee:** $0 (No Annual Fee)
- **Welcome Offer:** Earn 45,000 Bonus Points after spending $1,000 on eligible purchases in the first 3 months.
- **Earning Rates:**
  - Up to 14X total points per $1 spent at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels.
  - 2X points per $1 on grocery stores, select food delivery, rideshare, select streaming, internet, cable, and phone services.
  - 1X point per $1 on all other purchases.
- **Key Benefits:**
  - Automatic Silver Elite Status.
  - 5 Elite Night Credits every calendar year.
  - Access to Chase Pay Over Time® for qualifying travel purchases of $100–$5,000 with no interest or plan fees.
  - Pay Yourself Back option to redeem points for statement credits on travel purchases (up to $750/year).

---

#### **3. Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card**
- **Annual Fee:** $250
- **Welcome Offer:** Earn 125,000 bonus points plus a $150 statement credit after spending $5,000 in purchases in the first 6 months (Offer ends 9/30/2026).
- **Earning Rates:**
  - Up to 18.5X points at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels (6X from card, 10X member base, 2.5X Gold bonus).
  - 4X points per $1 at restaurants worldwide and U.S. supermarkets (up to $15,000 per calendar year, then 2X).
  - 2X points per $1 on all other eligible purchases.
- **Key Benefits:**
  - Complimentary Gold Elite Status.
  - 1,000 bonus points per paid eligible stay booked directly with Marriott.
  - 1 Free Night Award (up to 50,000 points) after spending $15,000 on eligible purchases in a calendar year.
  - 15 Elite Night Credits every calendar year.

---

#### **4. Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant® American Express® Card**
- **Annual Fee:** $650
- **Welcome Offer:** Earn 150,000 bonus points plus a $250 statement credit after spending $6,000 in purchases in the first 6 months (Offer ends 9/30/2026).
- **Earning Rates:**
  - Up to 21X points at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels (6X from card, 10X member base, 5X Platinum bonus).
  - 3X points per $1 at restaurants worldwide and on flights booked directly with airlines.
  - 2X points per $1 on all other eligible purchases.
- **Key Benefits:**
  - Complimentary Platinum Elite Status.
  - 1 Free Night Award every year after card renewal month (redemption level up to 85,000 points).
  - Up to $300 annual dining credit (up to $25/month in statement credits at restaurants worldwide).
  - Up to $100 property credit on qualifying 2-night minimum stays booked direct at The Ritz-Carlton® or St. Regis®.
  - 25 Elite Night Credits every calendar year.

---

### **Business Credit Card**

#### **5. Marriott Bonvoy Business® American Express® Card**
- **Annual Fee:** $125
- **Welcome Offer:** Earn 100,000 bonus points + 1 Free Night Award (up to 50,000 points) after spending $8,000 in purchases in the first 6 months (Offer ends 11/4/2026).
- **Earning Rates:**
  - Up to 18.5X points at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels (6X from card, 10X member base, 2.5X Gold bonus).
  - 4X points per $1 at restaurants worldwide, U.S. gas stations, wireless telephone services from U.S. providers, and U.S. shipping purchases.
  - 2X points per $1 on all other eligible purchases.
- **Key Benefits:**
  - Complimentary Gold Elite Status.
  - 1 Free Night Award every year after renewal month (up to 35,000 points), plus an additional Free Night Award after spending $60,000 in a calendar year.
  - 7% Marriott Bonvoy Room Rate Discount on eligible direct bookings.
  - 15 Elite Night Credits every calendar year.

---

### **International / Regional Cards**
Marriott also offers regional co-branded cards across Asia, Europe, Middle East, North America, and South America (including the UK, Canada, Japan, South Korea, China, India, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Mexico, and Brazil).
